scope: Original native TakeHit to Script::OnHit args, original Lua health ownership; portable args builder only. Not a collision solver or full damage multiplier port.

native_entry.TakeHit_complexity: Native function performs hit audiovisual effects, coverage block, effect/trait multipliers, armor/vulnerability/obstacle modifiers, damage rounding, native event/volley bookkeeping, Lua dispatch, attacker effect counters and OnHitWeapon request. Complete computation is retained as evidence and not replaced with constant damage here.
native_entry.attached_table_gate: At1802b8eaf..8ec4 require victim Thing.pAttachedLua pointer+0x150 and registryRef+0x158 both nonzero. Otherwise original OnHit callback loop is skipped.
native_entry.dispatch_order: Iterate original OnHit registrations atglobal RVA1ccfcc0..1ccfcc8; each Script::OnHit creates fresh table via Lua::NewTable(original TRIGGER_ARGS_TABLE_NAME), fills fields, then Script::run with victim and actual victim GetName. Source filter/common callback behavior is shared with opening-callback-contract.json.
native_entry.early_coverage: Certain directional coverage blocks invoke ScriptManager::OnProjectileBlock and return DamageResult before OnHit loop. Do not emit OnHit for that early-return path. Exact arc/weapon/projectile eligibility remains in retained native evidence; not yet portable.
native_entry.global_invulnerability: Thing::IsInvulnerable uses active animation invulnerable or live Life.IsInvulnerable; regular hit path passes this bool to OnHit instead of subtracting native health. Lua Damage handles its own blocking.

DamageResult.ownership: Result computed by native hit state; not remaining health. TotalDamageMultipliers is retained in DTO but not exposed as a separate field by Script::OnHit.

Script_OnHit_signature.caution: These descriptive names were mapped from actual field writes/stack slots, not recovered original parameter labels.

common.name: victim virtual GetName
common.TriggeredByTable: alias actual victim attached Lua table, not a copy

attacker_present.AttackerTable: alias actual attached table; nil when missing
attacker_present.MeetsEffectDamageMultiplier: passed bool, present only when actual attacker Thing supplied

args.attacker_absent_weapon_present: If Weapon.ownerId+0x30!=-1, emit AttackerId cached owner ID and AttackerName cached owner name+0x180. No fabricated attacker table. MeetsEffectDamageMultiplier/AttackerIsObstacle absent.

weapon_present.DealsDamageOrControlEffect: Weapon::DealsDamage OR actual projectile-valid flag and projectile effect Active=true,Duration>0, any DisableAttack/Move/Rotate

projectile_present.ImpactVelocity: 0 if victim has no physics or IsImmuneToForce; otherwise actual ProjectileData+0x618. Omitted entirely when no projectile.

effect_present.EffectIsTriggered: passed bool, only emitted when effect exists

args.ImpactAngle: double(radiansFloat)*exactdouble0x404ca5dc1a63c1f8, roundbackfloat32, then promote to Lua number. Equivalent C++ hexconstant0x1.ca5dc1a63c1f8p+5.
args.VictimIsTraitor: actual UnitStatus.mIsTraitor atUnit+0x4f0 when Unit; false for other thing types.
args.presence: Absent source kinds omit their field groups; do not manufacture empty weapon/effect/projectile names or tables.

lua_ownership.registration: Exactly one direct OnHit registration in bounded99-script directory search: Combat.lua2609, unfiltered.
lua_ownership.order: Original callback first resolves attacker/victim tables and weapon data, starts synchronous thread initial resumes for hit hooks/presentation; then calls Damage(victim,args) only if DamageAmount>0. The original scheduler owns subsequent yields.
lua_ownership.Damage_gate: Combat.lua722 returns when victim/table Health missing or alreadydead without PureDamage. Nonpure path blocks IsInvulnerable and Lua InvulnerableFlags/PersistentInvulnerableFlags, computes original damage multipliers/additions.
lua_ownership.health: Hero Health subtraction at791, enemy normal reduction at879. Do not subtract health in native builder before callback.
lua_ownership.death: Original Damage at812 checks Health<=0 and CannotDieFromDamage, phase/last-stand/death presentation then Kill(victim,args). Kill may call native actor destroy later; not a native pre-dispatch health loop.

portable_builder.semantics: Each Ready creates one fresh table, aliases actual owner tables, publishes exact global_triggerArgs and leaves table on stack. Missing victim attached table returns explicit skipped status; malformed identities/text/nonfinite values return error before publishing. Parent must invoke matching original callbacks and retain each args table across yields.
limits: DTO requires already computed native DamageResult and force/weapon/trait states. Builder cannot establish real collision or correct damage by itself.
Caller must resolve actual same-VM attached table indices; type check cannot establish that ownership by itself.
Finite/embedded-NUL validation is portable subset policy, not original rejection evidence.

test.kind: Synthetic observer of alias identity, conditional fields, radians conversion, globals/stack, untouched Health and invalid-input handling; not original gameplay.

remaining_unknowns: Portable full collision admission and complete TakeHit arithmetic/crit/coverage/volley/effect branches.
Native death/destroy ordering after original Lua Kill and full combat presentation/audio.
Actual all-effect callbacks and active owner changes during hit dispatch.
